global.grade: warm highlights, deep indigo shadows, soft painterly grain
global.lensing: 47-degree neutral perspective for shared action; 29-degree portrait isolation for emotional turns; gentle depth falloff
global.movement_grammar: slow push-ins on emotion; static frames for wonder; stabilized operator behavior throughout

scenes.shot_framing: medium two-shot at child eye level, stall glow frame-right
scenes.first_frame: Mira center-left holds Kenji's hand while both already move frame-right past the stall; Mira watches the stall and Kenji turns toward the drums
scenes.location_map: foreground hanging paper charms; Mira and Kenji in the midground lane; food stall background-right; crowd flows deep frame-right; warm key originates at the stall
scenes.optics: MS two-shot, 47-degree FOV held through the shot
scenes.camera_movement: slow push-in 30cm toward Mira as Kenji slips away
scenes.performance: Kenji's eyes widen toward the drums and his grip loosens; Mira's gaze snaps from the stall to his hand, jaw tightening
scenes.physics: their joined hands stretch before separating; sleeves and lantern tassels trail with the crowd movement; feet maintain contact with the wet stones
scenes.lighting: warm lantern key from the stall, cool night rim from frame-left
scenes.blocking: Mira center-left facing the stall; Kenji at her right hand, exits frame-right into crowd; 180 line along the stall front
scenes.sound_direction: festival drums and crowd murmur; drums swell as Kenji runs
scenes.negative_notes: no modern signage, no cars, crowd never menacing
positive_locks: all signage remains traditional painted festival boards
the lane contains pedestrians and wooden stalls
the background crowd remains festive and calm

scenes.shot_framing: wide single, Mira small in the empty lane, lantern glow center
scenes.first_frame: Mira stands small at frame-left, breathing hard and facing the fox lantern already floating at center; paper edges tremble in its warm light
scenes.location_map: soft out-of-focus stall curtain foreground-right; Mira and lantern midground; empty lane recedes into indigo background; lantern is the key source
scenes.optics: WS, 63-degree observational FOV held through the transformation
scenes.camera_movement: static frame; the transformation provides the motion
scenes.performance: Mira's shoulders stop heaving, eyes lift to the lantern, lips part, and her hands slowly unclench
scenes.physics: paper folds open along visible creases; warm air lifts the loose corners; the floating form has gentle inertia and casts a stable contact glow on the stones
scenes.lighting: single warm source from the lantern, indigo ambience, paper-glow bloom on unfold
scenes.blocking: Mira center facing camera-left toward the floating lantern; Hoshi materializes at her eye level
scenes.sound_direction: crowd fades to silence; paper rustle; single koto note on the bow
scenes.negative_notes: transformation must feel gentle, not startling
positive_locks: the transformation unfolds slowly with continuous paper motion
the lantern glow stays warm amber
